svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Viewer can locate a specific type of video or content by searching with text or by applyin
g filters. → Viewer can obtain the information they are after quickly through search inste
ad of reading long-form material such as a book.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
A search made with vague or imprecise criteria still returns meaningful results to the vie
wer. → Viewer can locate a specific type of video or content by searching with text or by

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Creator can attach a description to an uploaded video and, optionally, a transcript or cap
tions. → Viewer can browse visually through a large volume of content options, seeing thum
bnails with descriptions and creator or actor information, and click through them.

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 有助于
g.text: 待确认联系 · 有助于
Streaming can only begin 24 hours after a streaming account is set up. → The platform must
not allow streamers to share certain kinds of content with anybody.

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 有助于
g.text: 待确认联系 · 有助于
